method.short_corpus: 31 historical tasks, 30 primary plus count_secondary control; prompts 33-78 tokens, caps 384-1024. Reused calibration corpus, not independent validation.
method.heldout: 12 fresh prompts, 46-85 input tokens, caps 256-512. Frozen before use, used once. Output agreement only; no human quality grading.
method.long_corpus: Two repository-source excerpts, 8193/16385 tokens, 256/384 caps. Original four-case protocol narrowed before any long run/output to fit three groups inside8h, preserving prose/code and length endpoints. Distinct native serial comparison; not a rerun of failed HTTP groups.
method.native_positive_gate: Exactly three fixed ABBA groups; full output equality, all per-case/control spreads <=5%, operating checks, aggregate latency improvement strictly >max(2%, twice endpoint spread), every group required.
method.telemetry: Continuous macmon plus NSProcessInfo observations; one GPU job at a time. No heavy builds during controlled timing groups. Foreign applications were not stopped. Nominal thermal state alone does not establish constant GPU frequency.
method.sampling: Independent seeds, 1500 per context per arm, three contexts, 18-token cap. All candidate configurations frozen before candidate dataset outputs. Pearson chi-square with symmetric pooling and Holm across 234 reserved tests; finite regression screen, not equivalence proof.

protocol.nomination: At most3 source configurations; nominate and freeze all before inspecting any positive-temperature candidate outputs. Failed or nonbeneficial greedy screens do not need nomination.
protocol.tests: For each of3contexts:18singlepositions plus8adjacentpairs;78tests/comparison. AbsorbingSTOP for ended sequences; no conditioning on survival.
protocol.statistics: Pearson chi-square contingency test, no Yates correction, numerical chi-square survival via SciPy1.18.0. This is an asymptotic test, not Fisher exact. Symmetric pooled rare categories, expected cells>=5; degenerate tests uninformativep1. Holm correction across reserved234tests, unused comparisons paddedp1.
protocol.interpretation: Regression screen for gross sampling-distribution errors; no rejection is not proof of equivalence. Small/rare differences have limited power. Independent seed arms, rather than treating same-seed output equality as the correctness test. Greedy equality and independent operator equations remain separate checks.
protocol.source: SciPy official chi2_contingency documentation, observed2026-11-10, v1.18.0; modern statistical result replaces the archived study Wilson-Hilferty approximation.
protocol.pre_data_amendment_reason: Fourteen output tokens cannot cover every position of a trained16-row block. Before any sampling dataset starts, expand output cap to18 and add single positions14..17 and adjacent pairs14/15,15/16. All earlier settings and independent1500seeds remain; reserve234tests for up to3arms.

implementation_steps.name: Per-model geometry
details: Separate maximum capacity16 from actualdraft/verify width8or16; carry explicit typedgeometry from descriptor into model, scheduler/accounting, sampling andops.
Compile/select8and16specializations with distinct pipeline keys; preserve DF8 and all non-DS model behavior. Max-sized buffers need explicit active-stride semantics, not a global macro swap.
Keep KVPage32 and8192DScontextwindow; include changed tape/layout geometry in cache/build identities. Test checkpoint suffixes around31/32/33,8191/8192/8193 and longdiskrestore.

Remove researchglobalregisterdisable only after tableproducer/consumer support. Table16 is physically8rows; decouple its tile width from actualverifyRows. Host sum bytes currently divide byverifyRows and GDNwriter uses rowindex up to15 into8row layout. Either encode two8rowtables per16lane with all matching offsets/consumers, or explicitly reject unsupported layout selection.
Retain dense Qwen3.8+DSpine guard until other architectures have own geometry qualification.

implementation_steps.name: Wide gate/up pass policy
details: Prefer measured existingtwo-pass path if controlledapplication results confirm benefit; it avoids maintaining a newSGkernel.
Production calibration should constrain measured AF4G64M64 shape/device (this20coreApple10), preserve Ksplits and all<=32row policies. No environment variable in finalselection.
Keep SG2/SG4 research kernels and bitwise oracles as alternatives if a differentdevice wins; no cross-device claim from thisMac.

implementation_steps.name: Adaptive width
details: Start with batch-dependent8/16 policy, then evaluate accepted-prefix history using counts already returned to CPU; no additionalGPUreadback or command.

Use measured cyclecost bybatch and history, not acceptance ratio alone. If first7behavior agrees, m16<=m8+8*P(full7) gives a conservative upside bound at fixed contexts. Tail acceptance needs calibration.
Use hysteresis and a minimum sample window to avoidoscillation; account for switching/repacking/composite-state costs.
Freeze policy on calibrationcohort; use new mixed/concurrent heldout and completionlatency/fairness/contextmemory gates. Do not tune on existingheldout12 or sampling3 outcomes.

selection_model.expected_emitted_tokens: m_w = 1 + sum_{j=1}^{w-1} P(accepted_prefix >= j), with terminal/output-cap censoring handled separately.
selection_model.decision: Compare observed C16(B,L,pending-history)/m16 with C8(B,L,pending-history)/m8. Batch B, context L and previous accepted/pending GDN rows can affect cost. Use already returned counts/command timings; no extra GPU synchronization.
selection_model.conditional_bound: If the first seven proposal/acceptance behaviors agree, m16 <= m8 + 8*P(full7). Treat as a planning heuristic: matched-prefix experiment violates early-prefix equality in1/67 eligible primary cases.
selection_model.sampling_warning: Equal-weight overlapping prefix probes do not estimate request/cycle-weighted deployment acceptance. Freeze calibration on a separate corpus; do not tune from heldout12, sampling3 or new long-code comparison outcomes.

hindsight_whole_task_selection.interpretation: Descriptive hindsight whole-task selection on the same calibration data, with zero prediction/switching/storage overhead. Not an adaptive policy, performance qualification, or an upper bound on per-cycle switching or other workloads. This is only the observed ceiling of perfect whole-task selection on these means.

fidelity_followup.factorial: Then swap only native-versus-MLX target feature captures with the draft implementation fixed; separately test raw BF16 training-target features only when genuine target weights/hardware are available. Dequantizing a four-bit target does not recreate BF16 training features.
